reuse.why: Fintegra goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, the unlink column reset is extracted from unlinkAccount into clearBankLink and reused for replacement, and the Akahu downloader is generalised rather than copied.

duplication.why: One holder query (findLinkedAccountIds) serves both the refusal and the replacement, but the identical assertCanLinkBankAccount call block is repeated in each of the six provider functions.

placement.why: Link rules live in accounts/app.ts and downloads in sync.ts; the replace-link behaviour is split between the per-provider guard (early return) and linkBankSyncAccount (release), and the guard sits outside the shared link path.

scope.why: Contains an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts and small desktop-client edits although the client UI was declared out of scope.

maintainability.why: Clear small helpers, but each new provider must remember to call the guard itself, and linkBankSyncAccount's upgrade/insert branching is now split into two if/else blocks around the release step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All providers use linkBankSyncAccount, findOrCreateBank and the shared guard; unlinkAccount uses clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The downloader and unlink reset are genuinely shared; the repeated guard call is a visible repetition, not a reshaped copy.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and an if-branch that releases other holders (splitting its upgrade/insert logic); assertCanLinkBankAccount gains replaceExistingLink (early return) and a closed-account branch; processBankSyncDownload's akahu branch is widened with a fintegra case.
